The Question was
Create a soft link to the “docs” directory in the “project” and name it “documentation”

Screenshot 2024-10-08 2255061852×788 23.9 KB

It seems that the soft link documentation is created correctly, but its target needs to be an absolute path rather than a relative one.
Can any one explain why does relative path does not work

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Relative path is totally valid and will work. However this question is not correctly configured to accept that, so use absolute path instead

posts.name: Ishwar kumar

posts.name: User
posts.cooked:
If you see the red color in a softlink, then it means the softlink is broken (not created properly) and it won’t work.

Always create softlinks using absolute path rather than relative path.

posts.name: User
posts.cooked: Use ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_2/project while creating the hardlinks or softlinks.
